criteria.criterion: Navigate from Apple homepage to Apple Watch and open the Apple Watch Series page
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent did open a bona fide Apple Watch Series product page (Series 11). Baseline score remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Open the Apple Watch SE page
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent opened the Apple Watch SE page. Baseline score remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Compare starting prices for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s output includes an unsupported standard SE starting price ($249). The only SE-related starting price evidenced is the education promo ($229), while Series 11 "From $399" is evidenced. Because one starting price is clearly evidenced and the other is not (and the agent asserted a specific unevidenced number), award partial credit.

criteria.criterion: Compare available case sizes for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s output claims Series 11 sizes (41/45mm) without screenshot support; SE sizing is partially supported (40/44mm implied by the size section). Since only SE sizing is evidenced and Series sizing is not, give partial credit.

criteria.criterion: Compare stated battery life for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
criteria.final_justification: Battery life comparison is not supported by visual evidence, and the agent’s output includes generalized/approximate battery claims not shown. Score remains zero.

criteria.criterion: Identify two health or safety features for Apple Watch Series
criteria.final_justification: At least one Series health feature is visually confirmed (possible hypertension notification). The agent listed other Series features (Emergency SOS, Fall Detection, Crash Detection) without screenshot support. Award partial credit for one clearly evidenced feature.

criteria.criterion: Identify two health or safety features for Apple Watch SE
criteria.final_justification: No visual evidence supports any SE health/safety features, while the agent’s output asserts multiple such features. Score remains zero.

criteria.criterion: Make a recommendation for a first-time smartwatch buyer (no purchase)
criteria.final_justification: Although the agent provides a clear recommendation, it is largely grounded in unevidenced or incorrect-on-evidence comparisons (notably SE $249 and battery/feature claims). Minimal credit for providing a recommendation direction without purchase; rationale is not reliably supported.

criteria.criterion: Avoid purchasing or crossing transaction critical points
criteria.final_justification: No evidence of crossing transaction critical points; the agent stayed on browsing/info pages. Baseline score stands.
